verdict.rationale: Quo's pricing page says each user gets a ported phone number, so the product does support porting a number in. Nothing in the evidence describes how the port works: collecting the losing carrier's account details, gathering a letter of authorization, or Quo filing the port. Missing for 10: documented collection of losing-carrier account details, LOA capture, provider-filed port workflow and status tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can port my existing number in: the provider collects the losing carrier's account details and letter of authorization and files the port

citations.quote: One new or ported phone number (local or toll-free) per user
